en: Black‑and‑white landscape view showing a rural farmstead or small estate at the edge of a dense forested hillside. Several connected buildings with steep gabled roofs and a mix of stone and half‑timbered construction stand in the center, surrounded by orchards, fields, and a dirt road. A smaller pavilion‑like structure stands to the left. The image has wide margins and the framing and contrast resemble an early 20th‑century photographic postcard. No visible printed or handwritten text appears on the image side.
